svg.title: From the core to a system
svg.desc: Done in this crate: hashing and parsing, tested against the vectors. Next, in order: signatures through a vetted ML-DSA library; the cosigned subtree and checkpoint protocol with witnesses; the tiled log writer with a lock and staging, following Part 10; landmark allocation and validation, following Part 08; and certificate selection in TLS. Fuzzing for every parser throughout.

text.tspan: hashing, proofs, tiles, encodings, landmark check
signatures: ML-DSA from a vetted library, never hand-written
cosigners: subtree and checkpoint cosigning, witnesses
the log writer: tiles, lock, staging (Part 10)
TLS: trust anchor IDs and certificate selection
fuzz every parser: DER, MTCProof, tile paths, notes
each step gets its own vectors before its own code.
